headline.text: L1 S4 chiller not maintaining tunnel temps — line paused at 12:44, *low glycol* suspected, maintenance refilling before restart.

summary: Two active food-safety events: L1 S4 chiller failure paused production due to inadequate tunnel cooling; L1 discarded a bulging heavy cream tote. L3 ML4 lost most of shift to depositor piston faults and repeated ATP failures after maintenance disassembly. One rework hold on L1 S3.

holds.title: Pallet 41107 tagged for rework
holds.summary: S3 Pack isolated pallet 41107 for rework; QA applied hold tag at end of window.

food_safety.title: S4 chiller failure — tunnels not reaching temp
food_safety.summary: Chiller unable to maintain correct tunnel temperatures; line paused at 12:44, maintenance believes low glycol is root cause and is refilling system before restart.
food_safety.status: Line paused; maintenance refilling glycol to restore cooling capacity.

food_safety.title: Heavy cream tote bulging — discarded
food_safety.summary: One tote of heavy cream found bulging ("ready to pop"); discarded to prevent potential rupture and contamination risk.

quality.title: S2 MM6 printer failure
quality.summary: MM6 printer threw unrecoverable error twice; Videojet diagnostic says cannot be repaired without service call — touchscreen also non-functional; decision made to swap with rework printer to keep line running.
quality.status: Resolved for production — swapped with rework printer; Videojet service call to be scheduled.

quality.title: Almonds past expiration date
quality.summary: S2 operator flagged almonds past expiration date; requested verification with IMS on whether expiration will be extended.
quality.status: Open — awaiting Mary Montilla and Charity Young confirmation on expiration extension.

quality.title: ML1 damaged slider and bent fins
quality.summary: East-side depositor slider damaged enough to bind during chocolate deposit; fins also bent from previous drop of sliders — both discovered during troubleshooting of piston faults.
quality.status: Slider and fins identified; line did not achieve production startup today due to ongoing depositor issues.

sanitation.title: Two allergen swabs failed on panning equipment
sanitation.summary: Two allergen verification swabs failed during post-clean ATP testing on panning/sorting equipment; both recleaned and passed by 16:20.
sanitation.status: Resolved — both areas recleaned and passed allergen verification.

sanitation.title: ML4 depositor 1 failed ATP after maintenance work
sanitation.summary: Depositor 1 disassembled for piston fault troubleshooting; failed ATP post-reassembly despite passing last week — hopper, nozzle plate, and sliders re-washed and re-tested until all passed by 16:51.
sanitation.status: Resolved — all depositor 1 components passed ATP after re-wash; line still down at window close due to recurring piston faults.

sanitation.title: S3 chutes modified, ATP tested before reinstall
sanitation.summary: Maintenance modified cereal belt and cross-conveyor chutes to address product spillage; parts cleaned and ATP tested before reinstallation at 14:48.
sanitation.status: Resolved — chutes passed ATP and reinstalled; line restarted at 15:02.

opportunities.text: Review chiller glycol level monitoring and PM schedule for S4 — today's line pause due to low glycol suggests fill interval may need tightening.
Consider pre-shift visual inspection checklist for dairy totes (bulging, leaks, damage) across all lines — today's bulging heavy cream tote on S2 caught late in shift.
Consider adding depositor slider handling and inspection SOP to ML1 and ML4 startup procedures — today's bent fins and damaged slider at ML1 both traced to dropping during disassembly.
